address: Ronda Universitat nº 35, Eixample, 08007 Barcelona, Spain
name: Alcam Plaza Cataluña
description:
About this propertySpacious Accommodation: Alcam Plaza Cataluña in Barcelona offers a spacious apartment with three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The living room includes a sofa bed and a dining area, providing ample space for relaxation and meals.

Modern Amenities: Guests benefit from free WiFi, air-conditioning, and a fully equipped kitchenette with a coffee machine, microwave, and dishwasher. Additional amenities include a washing machine, work desk, and parquet floors.

Prime Location: Located in the city centre, the apartment is a short walk from Plaça de Catalunya and Portal de l'Angel. Nearby attractions include Tivoli Theatre and Palau de la Musica Catalana, each less than 1 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

Guest Favorites: Guests appreciate the convenient location, family-friendly environment, and suitability for city trips.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
